verdict.rationale: Publishing upfront account, credential and identity-proofing requirements is a fair question for an IP office that runs online filing, so the axis applies. However, the filing pages in the pack (trademark, design, patent, e-Soleau) are titles only and say nothing about which account or identity steps a filer must complete before starting. The data.inpi.fr probe concerns the open-data portal rather than filing, and it shows a token requirement encountered as a 403, not one stated in advance.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes exactly which account, credential, and identity-proofing steps stand between me and filing — stated before I start, not discovered mid-flow
